properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
-ABASUMBA baali bakuuma,
-Endiga zaabwe-ekiro,
Malayika n'akka ku nsi
N'eyakaayakana.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mmwe-abasumba temwekanga
Ndeese-amawulire
-Ag'essanyu lingi nnyo nnyini
Eri-abantu bonna.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Leero mu kyalo kya Dawudi
Era mu kika kye,
Muzaaliddwa-Omulokozi,
Yesu lye linnya lye.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Omwana munaamulaba
Ng'azazikiddwa-eri
Ng'abikkiddwa mu bugoye
Mu kiraalo ky'ente.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Amangu ne walabika,
Mu ggulu ne ku nsi,
Eggye-erya bamalayika
Ne bayimba bati:

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Katonda -aweebwe-ekitiibwa
Mu ggulu ne mu nsi:
-Emirembe gibe mu bantu
Bonna-abasiimibwa.
